about: Starter manager notes for the Nine Cat War Room, shared by Vikas on Nov 11 2026. His read of each manager from calls and chats, trimmed to what holds for any team. This starter copy is in the public repo because Vikas chose to share it. Copy it out of the project folder before you add your own notes, and never push your own copy.

1.name: Vinny
tips: Fair manager on his end. Cares about draft order and points, so lead with an even deal on those terms
Lead with the reasoning and real numbers he can check
Never stretch a fact
Leave him a small visible edge or a clear reason it is even
Plan the fallback before sending, he will counter
Thinks in draft rounds and weighs draft order and current stats most
Will not pay for upside talk or speculation. Wants known production
Rookies only at a discount for the risk
Will move Isaiah Hartenstein
Jaren Jackson Jr. only for a lot
No two for one now, no roster room. Maybe later in the season
No late pieces. Players taken in the last two rounds or picked up after the draft do nothing for him, unless he sends a late piece back
Oct 23, keeps Alexander-Walker and Michael Porter Jr. Dejounte Murray was on the market, but he loves him and is iffy on moving him
Oct 23, a rebound and big man team that punts assists

2.name: Anshu
tips: Rarely checks the app
Nov 5, chases assists and rebounds, wants players who give those
Nov 5, said he will move Acuff, Zion, Naz Reid and Champagnie, nobody else
Nov 6, sat 8th, strong FT% and PTS, weak REB and AST
Names his own deals and offers straight swaps. Thinks in names and in points, rebounds and assists, not turnovers
Nov 6, has not offered Flagg, Maxey, Embiid, Booker, George, Jarrett Allen, Braun, Anunoby or Washington, treat them as off the table
Send one clear offer by text with two lines of why and leave it a day
Small straight swaps he has floated himself get a yes, bigger packages sit unanswered

3.name: Chris
tips: Chris is Cristian and runs Extraterrestrial. Nothing else known yet, so start with an even deal and ask what he needs

4.name: Haziq
tips: Lead with a center and with blocks and rebounds
Argue by cats, not by ranks or stars
He reads the news, so answer injury and role points head on
Picked up Mitchell Robinson and rates him

6.name: Russi
tips: Make the case easy for an AI to check. Plain numbers, cats, games and roles
He needs forwards and guards and has a center surplus
Wants two pieces for Ware and thinks Ware splits center minutes evenly with Myles Turner
Send one offer and give it days
A deal that looks fair to the group helps
Has said he has no urgency to trade
Thinks Bam is worth a first round player
Will never trade for a waiver player, sees no value in them
Does not care about threes made, do not sell 3PM to him
May drop a good player without much thought, so check his drops after every scan

7.name: Aditya
tips: Offer a guard for forward or center swap
Explain it with numbers and expect pushback before a yes
Keep the first offer clearly fair, a light one risks a group chat callout
Nov 8, fine moving Miles Bridges
Never takes waiver wire players unless they start going off
Wins turnovers by small margins and guards it, so do not sell him extra turnovers as free
First in the league and may wait two or three weeks to trade
May drop a good player without much thought, so check his drops after every scan

8.name: Rohan
tips: Keep it to one short message with the few numbers that matter
Show him what his team is missing, he does not follow his roster closely
Expect lowball counters and do not chase
Nov 8, said he may be open to a trade
Will not trade Tyrese Haliburton
May drop a good player without much thought, so check his drops after every scan

12.name: Nitin
tips: Nitin runs LeGM's Team
Call him, he rarely answers texts
Keep it calm and factual, he is level headed
Likes the Lakers, which can open the conversation
